{{Recipe summary
| Category = Meat recipes
| Yield = 4 burgers
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] powder
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
*About ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta cheese]]

== Procedure ==
# Mix spices into beef, using hands, until well-mixed. 
# Form 8 small balls of meat, then press into very flat [[Cookbook:Pancake|pancake]] shapes. 
# Top four with about 2 tbsp crumbled feta cheese, then cover with the other four.
# Press together firmly to flatten, then crimp edges tightly to make four burgers. Chill.
# Cook as regular burgers in a [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] or on the [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]]. Handle gently to avoid crumbling. 
# Serve on toasted white or [[Cookbook:Rye|rye]] [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] with spicy [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Any other [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] that doesn’t melt easily can be substituted for feta in this recipe. Some possibilities are [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan]], [[Cookbook:Swiss Cheese|Swiss]], and [[Cookbook:Jarlsberg|Jarlsberg]]. If you use a cheese that melts and becomes runny, however, it will all drip out.
* If you plan to grill the burgers, you can opt to mix the feta in with the beef and simply treat as regular burgers. Don’t try this on a skillet, however, as the cheese will stick and burn.
